name: great_cto
tagline_zh: CTO一句话，全流程自动跑：从需求拆解到代码评审，连测试和部署都替你盯完。省下你催进度的口舌，还附赠一份风险清单。
tagline_en: CTO says it once, the full SDLC runs itself: from spec to review, tests, deploy, plus a risk list you didn't ask.
desc_en: Use when the CTO describes a feature, task, or project goal. Orchestrates the full SDLC pipeline automatically based on project type.
why_zh: 同类只写代码，它按项目类型自动编排整个研发流水线，连验收标准和风险预警都内置，像多了一个不睡觉的副手。
why_en: Others just code; this one auto-orchestrates the entire pipeline per project type, with built-in acceptance checks and risk.
